changes: Added strict build-time Tier 5 depth boundary with no runtime depth enforcement.
Removed production core XorShift/time-seeded OTAC issuance path; production entropy remains outside authoritative core.
Added WAL page scanner for checksum/data-length/strict sequence validation.
Preserved WAL sequence across restart via open_with_sequence and checked increment.
Separated Missing/Empty/Unreadable/Corrupt/Present boot states and fail-closed on ambiguous identity.
Existing WAL without trusted anchor no longer passes as clean start.
WalRecord now explicitly carries schema_version, monotonic_counter, prev_state_hash, event_hash, spec_hash, signature_set_hash and checksum.
Added strict canonical frame decode and validated physical-page payload reassembly.
Daemon authoritative writes now use DurableWal plus WalRecord instead of raw ShadowWal payload writes.
unresolved: P3 remains partial: fixed-size segmentation, exact partial-tail recovery, durable snapshots, replay state/Merkle comparison, crash-loop SAFE MODE and durability fault injection remain unresolved.
Fixed-size WAL segmentation, snapshot replay root comparison, partial-tail repair policy, crash-loop protection, and explicit recovery/genesis decision flow remain to be verified or implemented.
Allocator isolation/no-system-fallback boundary remains unresolved for std/napi consumers.
Railway deployment plane may report FAILED after successful build/image push; runtime deployment success is not claimed.
